definitions.gloss: to correct; to straighten; to adjust
definitions.explanation: To fix something that is wrong or out of place. Often used for correcting posture, behavior, or errors.
To formally ask or inquire about something, especially to verify facts or seek clarification.

examples.japanese: {姿勢|しせい}を{正|ただ}してください。

examples.english: To straighten one's collar (to compose oneself).

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{姿勢|しせい}を{正|ただ}す (to straighten one's posture)
・{襟|えり}を{正|ただ}す (to straighten one's collar - idiom meaning to compose oneself formally)
・{間違|まちが}いを{正|ただ}す (to correct a mistake)
・{真偽|しんぎ}を{正|ただ}す (to inquire about the truth)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{直|なお}す (to fix/repair - more general)
・{訂正|ていせい}する (to correct - for written errors)
